reviewer: implementation agent; independent data-steward sign-off pending
policy: A candidate is not approved data. No raw matrix was downloaded or hashed. Donor counts are recorded only when a reviewed page stated them, and those statements were not re-counted from raw files. Synthetic fixtures are not benchmark datasets.

candidates.rights: not confirmed as public-domain or permissive benchmark reuse
candidates.repository_support: not assessed beyond the GEO series page
candidates.notes: The Cytotherapy article says RNA-seq and MACE-seq sequences are in GSE269586 and discusses secretome measurements. This entry does not claim that a proteomics or functional-assay matrix is inside the GEO accession. Donor count and sample counts were not stated in the excerpts reviewed here.

Sun et al., Stem Cell Research & Therapy, 2020, state that the data are deposited in CNSA under CNP0000562 and that scRNA-seq covered primary WJ-MSCs from three donors. The methods also describe bulk RNA-seq. Donor identifiers and passage were not extracted from raw files. The paper's comparison series GSE76081 is adipose MSC data and is rejected below as a WJ source.

candidates.tissue: Wharton's jelly and bone marrow MSC comparison
candidates.repository_support: not assessed beyond the GEO abstract
candidates.notes: GEO describes a single-cell comparison of hWJSCs and hBMMSCs. Sun et al. 2020 cite this comparison as 103 hWJSC from three cords and 63 hBMMSC from two donors. Those counts were not re-derived from the GEO matrix in this sprint, so donor_count stays null.

candidates.perturbations: IL-1beta, TNF-alpha and IL-17 at 3, 6 and 12 ng for 4, 24 and 48 h, as stated in the reviewed PRIDE sample-processing protocol
candidates.repository_support: not stated in the reviewed PRIDE summary
candidates.notes: Secretome proteomics of primed WJ-MSCs. The paper describes functional readouts, but those assay tables were not deposited as a hashed Cyra matrix. Donor count was not in the reviewed excerpts. Numeric fold-changes in the abstract are not imported measurements.

candidates.perturbations: isolation method comparison and FGF2, as stated on the ProteomeXchange summary
candidates.repository_support: ProteomeXchange summary says supported dataset by repository
candidates.notes: Intracellular proteome across isolation methods. The linked PLOS ONE DOI is the publication listed by ProteomeXchange; the paper was not re-extracted. Donor count was not stated in the reviewed summary.

candidates.passage: P3, P5 and P10, as stated on the MassIVE summary
candidates.perturbations: conditioned-medium collection at 24, 48 and 72 h; three technical runs; 81 samples stated on the summary
candidates.rights: MassIVE summary states CC0 1.0 and Partial Public
candidates.repository_support: Partial Public; full anonymous retrieval of every file was not tested
candidates.notes: The MassIVE summary states 3 donors, passages P3/P5/P10, collection at 24/48/72 h, 3 technical runs and 81 samples, with 244 files and 102.33 GB listed. None of those files were downloaded. A different accession, PXD056000, has a similar title and its ProteomeXchange description says 2 donors; that conflict is why this candidate is not treated as a settled cohort. No paired transcript or functional-assay matrix is in this accession.

rejected.reason: GSE35585 is the ENCODE/SUNY Albany RIP-seq series. GSM2400244 is one RNA-seq sample described as Wharton's jelly mesenchymal stem cells from the umbilical cord of one newborn male. It is not a multi-donor measurement matrix with passage, batch, secreted protein and a functional assay.
Sun et al. 2020 use GSE76081 as adipose-derived MSC bulk RNA-seq for comparison. It is not a Wharton's jelly dataset and is not eligible as one.

gap.summary: No approved independent dataset provides paired transcript, secreted protein and functional assay measurements with donor identifiers, passage, batch, an open reuse license and hashed raw matrices.
gap.owners: data steward and evaluation lead; named assignees pending
